title: Communicate with customs
goal: Every declaration, query and audit request has its facts, documents and timeline assembled with the gaps listed, and the founder or a licensed customs broker made every filing and every statement to the authority.

steps.do: Assemble everything the declaration needs, the classification, the value, the origin, the parties, the delivery term and any licence, and list every field no document supports.

consider.why: A declaration is a statement to a government, and every field in it has to come from a document.
consider.when: A shipment requires a customs declaration.

steps.do: Hand the assembled declaration to the founder or the licensed customs broker, who files and signs it; the agent never files with a customs authority and never writes to one.

consider.why: Filing is a regulated act, and in most places only the importer of record or a licensed broker may do it.
consider.when: A declaration is assembled and must be filed.

steps.do: Assemble the facts, documents and dated timeline the query asks about, say plainly what cannot be produced, and hand it to the founder and the broker, who reply.

consider.why: A query has its own deadline, and the first reply sets what the rest of the matter argues about.
consider.when: A customs authority has raised a query, a hold or an audit request.

steps.do: Raise each field no document supports and each query deadline as a decision for the founder, with what a wrong or late answer would cost.

done_criteria.check: Was every declaration and every reply filed by the founder or a licensed broker, and does each one list the fields no document supports?
